checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Single 6 s clip, frames sampled across 0.6–5.7 s.
Round copper robot with glowing blue eyes in all frames.
Large clear sunflower on the right in all frames, more in the background.

must.item: Robot waters the sunflower, water reaching plant or soil
must.why: Watering can spouts water that falls toward the flower and soil in frames 2–4.

faults.what: Robot is not very tiny relative to the sunflower; scale is ambiguous, with the flower head cropped at top.
Water stream is somewhat smeary and translucent, and the can spout and robot arm positions are slightly inconsistent between frames (a small AI artefact).
The robot's body and legs look slightly odd, with the body shape changing across frames. The robot appears to change a little over the clip.

summary: A warm golden-hour clip of a copper robot with blue eyes pouring water from a can onto a sunflower and its soil; it meets the brief, with only minor AI artefacts in the water and robot anatomy.
